hardware: 2 x RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell at 375 W, CPU socket at 225 W
task: Single-client actual Pi session debugging an isolated extract of model-cli Go compose flag parsing. One historical task repeated with three paired session IDs. Public failing test and independent held-out tests.
method: Fresh server, private prefix cache and one fresh launch followed by two warm launches per leg. The full task samples are descriptive. Go compilation cache prewarmed and privately copied for every agent and grader. Pi wall includes model requests and local tools and excludes independent grading. API output rate includes prefill and delivery. Engine request counts must exclude other callers.

frozen_turn_replay.method: Identical request captured after a real failing test, capped at 256 tokens. Each leg used one warm-up and six warm responses. All output hashes, prompt length and measured prefix reuse matched across legs. Streaming decode uses 255 first-to-last intervals with no bundled tool calls.

pi_high_effort_trial.method: After the primary sweep, repeat the same three session identifiers, cold first then two warm launches, on the same selected engine image. Pi selects high, keeping the original 64k output limit, prompt, temperature, fixture, deadlines and grader. Only the reasoning setting was changed in the launcher invocation. Secondary task-level observations on one fixture.
